source.label: Dynamic World endpoint metrics
source.description: July–October 2015 versus 2025, 10 m grid, mean tree probability >=0.5, >=2 predictions per endpoint. No extrapolation.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run the R scripts described in README.md. Input/output: data/dynamic_world/zone_rankings_and_coverage.csv

metricDefinitions.label: Dynamic World endpoint metrics
metricDefinitions.definition: Change (%) = 100*(loss_km2+gain_km2)/common_km2; paired coverage (%) =100*common_km2/region_km2. Null change where no paired area.

source.label: Nigeria annual mapped gross loss
source.description: GFC 2025 v1.13, 2015–2025 inclusive; year-2000 canopy >=30%; mapped land only.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run the R scripts described in README.md. Input/output: data/hansen/annual_nigeria_loss.csv

metricDefinitions.label: Nigeria annual mapped gross loss
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of geodesic pixel area assigned to each annual loss code across the six zones; km² = hectares/100. Gross loss, not net change or permanent deforestation.

source.label: Six-zone mapped gross loss
source.description: GFC 2025 v1.13; sum of eleven annual loss observations, 2015–2025. Cell-centre boundary inclusion.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run the R scripts described in README.md. Input/output: data/hansen/zone_totals_and_size_adjustment.csv

metricDefinitions.label: Six-zone mapped gross loss
metricDefinitions.definition: Loss / zone area (%) =100*total_loss_ha/region_area_ha. Geographic size adjustment does not control for baseline tree cover.

source.label: Sample-based classification sensitivity
source.description: 200 random points per zone, seed 20152025, 10 m sampling, July–October 2015/2025.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run the R scripts described in README.md. Input/output: validation/classification_sensitivity_sample.csv

metricDefinitions.label: Sample-based classification sensitivity
metricDefinitions.definition: Nine combinations: mean tree probability 0.4/0.5/0.6 and >=1/2/3 predictions. 100*(loss_points+gain_points)/paired_points; null where paired_points=0. Not full-area estimates or independent accuracy validation.

source.label: Candidate high-loss cell groups
source.description: 10 km grid; groups use integer gx/gy queen adjacency. Singletons are in the table but only groups >=2 cells are outlined in the figure.

evidenceFlow.title: Reproduce
evidenceFlow.detail: Run the R scripts described in README.md. Input/output: data/dynamic_world/candidate_cluster_summary.csv

metricDefinitions.label: Candidate high-loss cell groups
metricDefinitions.definition: Eligible cells: >=50% paired coverage and >=1 km² baseline tree area. High loss: top decile of positive loss / baseline-tree area. Not a significance test.
